sentences.text: Google Cloud's incident continues in our region, us-central1 [C-005][C-019].
Login/API reliability has been impaired since 17:51 UTC [C-001].
Cloudflare's Access outage affects staff's internal-tool access [C-010][C-011].
Google applied mitigations [C-017].
Evidence conflicts: Google's support account denies disruptions; its status page confirms an incident [C-021].
The undisclosed cause, recovery time, and Cloudflare KV data-loss status remain unknown [C-003][C-004][C-024].
We're throttling retries and preparing request replay [R-16][R-14].
Naming is decided: retain “our cloud provider” in live updates [R-12].
We'll update at 20:15 [R-17].
Google Cloud's incident still affects us-central1, Northwind's only region; Firestore and Firebase Auth calls return 503s [C-005] [C-019] [C-009] [C-006].
Cloudflare's outage affects Access authentication used by staff; services are starting to recover [C-011] [C-010] [C-020].
Root cause, Northwind recovery time, and whether Workers KV lost data remain unknown [C-003] [C-004] [C-024].
Keep deploys frozen and staff on break-glass access; prepare failed-request replay and throttle retries and job restarts [R-7] [R-11] [R-14] [R-16].
BGP and ConnectWise explanations are unverified and should not be acted on [C-014] [C-022].
Do not roll back until a change is implicated [R-3].
Next update at 20:15 [R-17].
We're sorry customers have been unable to reliably log in or use our API since 17:51 UTC [C-001].
Our cloud provider has confirmed an incident [C-005].
The cause remains undisclosed, and recovery time is not yet known [C-003] [C-004] [C-017].
We're preparing to replay failed requests [R-14].
We'll update you again at 20:15 UTC [R-17].
